title: RSF Kills 27 Civilians in al-Murrah Villages West of Barah, North Kordofan — Eid al-Adha Attack
detail: On May 29, 2026 — the second day of Eid al-Adha — RSF-affiliated paramilitary forces attacked villages in the al-Murrah area west of Barah town, North Kordofan State, killing at least 27 civilians including elderly residents. The Sudan Doctors Network accused RSF fighters of targeting the villages, which had no military presence. Barah is strategically significant: RSF recaptured the town in March 2026 to maintain pressure on SAF's North Kordofan counteroffensive axis. The al-Murrah villages lie in contested territory west of Barah where RSF has maintained a presence since its 2023 Kordofan expansion. The holiday attack continues a documented RSF pattern of conducting atrocities against civilian populations in North Kordofan during religious observances, exploiting periods when SAF operational tempo is reduced. The event was confirmed by AP reporting, with coverage in the Washington Post, US News & World Report, Arab News, and Asharq Al-Awsat.

media.caption: RSF-affiliated forces killed at least 27 civilians in al-Murrah villages west of Barah, North Kordofan, on the second day of Eid al-Adha.

title: SAF Continues Drone Interdiction Campaign Across North Kordofan as Kordofan Counteroffensive Advances
detail: SAF continued its sustained drone strike campaign targeting RSF positions across North Kordofan on May 29, 2026, maintaining air pressure on RSF supply lines and force concentrations as the broader SAF Kordofan counteroffensive progresses. North Kordofan is the critical corridor linking RSF-controlled Darfur to central Sudan; SAF has been methodically interdicting RSF logistics along this axis throughout May 2026. Recent SAF gains include the Dibebad crossroads (May 22–23), Dilling siege relief (May 19–20), Wadi al-Atrun supply route interdiction (May 19), and Al-Hamadi capture (May 13). SAF drone strikes serve both to support advancing ground forces and to degrade RSF capabilities, though OHCHR documented at least 880 civilians killed by drones across both sides in January–April 2026, with strikes frequently hitting civilian areas. The RSF's holiday attack on al-Murrah villages occurred within this broader North Kordofan operational context.
